import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (2 duplicates; 62 rows -> 60 unique penguins)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Normalize species case variants (adelie -> Adelie, gentoo -> Gentoo)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix island typos
    island_map = {'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_map)
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors): take absolute value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Enforce valid ranges
    df = df[df['bill_length_mm'].between(30, 60)]
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'].between(170, 235)]
    df = df[df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
